features.name: any_counter_comment_url
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain a direct URL or external link?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings; if missing or malformed return null. Empty list -> 0. Return 1 if any comment matches regex r'(https?://|www\.)\S+' (case-insensitive), else 0. Raw text match; no semantic filtering.

h0: any_counter_comment_url is unrelated to the likelihood of OP view change.
h1: Discussions with any_counter_comment_url=1 have a higher likelihood of view change than those with 0.
note: Operational assumption: "solely internal text" is operationalized as no URL in any counter-comment. Detection is literal http(s)/www matching; markdown links with URLs are caught, bare domains without scheme are not. Comments may contain outcome-related text or links to delta rules; not filtered. Comment timing unknown. Association only, not causal.
